primary.title: RBI brings 60 tonnes of gold home from overseas vaults in six months amid falling global prices: What numbers tell us
primary.summary: The RBI held 880.52 tonnes of gold at the end of September, shifting 60.08 tonnes from overseas vaults to domestic storage over six months. However, gold’s share of forex reserves fell as international gold prices eased.

related.title: RBI data shows gold reserves dipped by over 8% to $106 billion in September 2026: Details here
related.summary: Despite the decline in gold reserves, the overall foreign exchange reserve grew by over 6 per cent to $737.79 billion from April to September this year.
